zh: 每台服务器需要的攻击次数是固定的 p = ⌈health/k⌉；它在被关闭之前每秒都贡献 request 个请求，所以总请求数等于“每台服务器的关闭时刻 × 它的 request”之和，再加最后的 1。
交错攻击不会更好：把攻击按完成顺序连续安排，任何服务器的完成时间都不会变晚。于是问题变成带权完成时间最小化的单机排序：比较相邻两台 i、j，先做 i 更优当且仅当 p_i·w_j < p_j·w_i。
为每台服务器算出 (p, w=request)，按 p/w 升序排序（用交叉相乘的整数比较避免浮点）；依次累加 elapsed += p，答案 += elapsed × w，初值为 1；用 64 位整数。
en: Each server needs a fixed number of attacks p = ceil(health/k); it contributes request requests every second until it is shut down, so the total equals the sum over servers of (shutdown time x request), plus the final 1.

Interleaving attacks never helps: scheduling each server's attacks contiguously in completion order makes no server finish later. The problem becomes single-machine weighted completion time: for adjacent servers i and j, doing i first is better exactly when p_i*w_j < p_j*w_i.

For each server compute (p, w = request), sort by p/w ascending using the integer cross-product comparison instead of floating point; then accumulate elapsed += p and answer += elapsed*w starting from answer = 1, using 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A server needs p = ceil(health/k) attacks and has weight request. Process the servers contiguously in ascending order of p/request, comparing ratios with integer cross products.

## Proof of correctness

Any interleaved attack plan can be rearranged to handle the servers contiguously in their completion order, so that no server finishes later; hence there is an optimal solution without interleaving. For adjacent jobs i and j, the cost saved by putting i before j instead of the reverse is determined by p_i*w_j - p_j*w_i; sorting by this ratio removes every inversion and is therefore optimal. The total number of requests is the sum of completion time x request, plus the final 1.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
